# North Stardust

> North Stardust is an independent creative studio and a home for original Intellectual Property, developed as a long-term creative practice exploring ideas, worlds and publishing. It is led by Athanasios Zagkliveris, Founder and Creative Director.

## Pages

- [Home](https://northstardust.studio/): The studio's hero statement and its focus — The Compass, The Studio and its work, The Horizon, and Athanasios Zagkliveris, Founder and Creative Director.
- [Publishing](https://northstardust.studio/publishing.html): North Stardust's published work. Coming soon.
- [Privacy Policy](https://northstardust.studio/privacy.html): How the site handles personal data — the contact form, analytics, and the rights a visitor has.

## Sections of the Home page

- [Contact](https://northstardust.studio/#contact): Get in touch about a project, collaboration or idea. Not a separate page — `/contact` is only a redirect kept for old links.
